page_title: NOT 1-1 WOL | Nottingham Forest v Wolves 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+11' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
90+10' Simon Hooper shows the yellow card to Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) for a heavy challenge.
90+8' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
90+5' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
90+4' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.
90+3' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+1' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Elliot Anderson and he is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) is on for Anthony Elanga.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) for a tough tackle.
88' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Andre (Wolves) coming on for Jorgen Strand Larsen.
86' Mario Lemina (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Chris Wood (Nottingham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
85' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) will take the corner.
83' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

81' Neco Williams (Nottingham) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
80' Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Callum Hudson-Odoi.
80' He should have scored! Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
78' Gary O'Neil (Wolves) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Simon Hooper blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Wolves earn a free kick.
75' Problems for Gary O'Neil as Nelson Semedo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Matt Doherty (Wolves) replaces him.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) is replacing Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
74' The foul by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
71' CHANCE! Chris Wood (Nottingham) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Sam Johnstone, who produces an excellent reflex save.
69' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
66' The referee awards a corner and Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes over to take it.

65' Chris Wood (Nottingham) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
62' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' It will be a substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as Rayan Ait-Nouri walks off.
60' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Joao Gomes is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
59' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ibrahim Sangare will be replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).

57' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Sam Johnstone easily makes the save. The ball is out of play. Nottingham win a corner kick.
57' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
55' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Nottingham are awarded the free kick.
53' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gets a yellow card. The referee Simon Hooper made the right call.
53' Joao Gomes (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
51' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Nottingham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The foul by Toti (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simon Hooper.
45' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

44' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
43' Matz Sels pulls off a glorious save! Craig Dawson (Wolves) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
41' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Simon Hooper blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.
40' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) receives a yellow card!

40' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Wolves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
39' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
38' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Nottingham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
35' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the top left corner, but Sam Johnstone denies him. Nottingham win a corner.
32' Today's referee Simon Hooper rightly decides to book Joao Gomes (Wolves) for his harsh tackle.
32' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Nottingham will take a free kick near the side line.

30' Joao Gomes (Wolves) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
29' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

25' That was close by Matheus Cunha (Wolves)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
24' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
24' Simon Hooper interrupts the game. One of the players from Nottingham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolves.

22' Chris Wood (Nottingham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
21' Neco Williams (Nottingham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
18' Neco Williams (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sam Johnstone, who smothers the ball.
16' Toti (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.

12' 1 - 1 Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) controls the ball with a great first touch just outside the penalty area after receiving a pass and smashes the ball into the roof of the net to give the goalkeeper no chance!
10' 1 - 0 Gooal! Elliot Anderson takes over corner duties. Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 1:0.
10' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
10' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has received a yellow card for his foul.
8' Simon Hooper blows for a foul after Murillo (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Wolves have a free kick.
7' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Joao Gomes (Wolves). Simon Hooper saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Nottingham.
6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

5' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
4' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simon Hooper.
